articles.title: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin begin unprecedented summit in China
articles.description: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin opened their first trilateral talks in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC forum, a meeting analysts expect to offer more symbolism than breakthroughs and that critics fear could carve the world into spheres of influence. Ukraine, the Iran war, nuclear disarmament and AI are all expected to come up, while Trump and Xi also held one-on-one talks on trade and technology.

articles.title: Nuclear arms at the center of the Shenzhen trilateral meeting
articles.description: Nuclear weapons are at the top of Donald Trump’s agenda at the trilateral summit in Beijing. The US president wants the United States, Russia and China to reduce their nuclear stockpiles, and FRANCE 24’s Philip Turle expects him to push hard for a three-way agreement on the issue. Iran is also a key part of the discussion. The three leaders share an interest in preventing the Iranian regime from acquiring nuclear weapons. Regional conflicts and oil prices are also se to be central issues.
